questions.prompt: Which Caribbean nation became independent in 1804 after a successful revolution?
questions.fact: Haiti's revolt was the only slave uprising in history to found an independent state. France then demanded reparations for its lost 'property', which Haiti paid off in 1947.

questions.prompt: Which process lets body cells divide for growth and repair?
questions.fact: Mitosis copies a cell into two identical ones. Meiosis is the other kind, and it halves the chromosomes to make egg and sperm cells.

questions.prompt: In rugby, what kick can follow a try?
questions.fact: The conversion is worth two extra points and must be taken in line with where the try was grounded, so scoring nearer the posts makes the kick far easier.

questions.prompt: Which yellow Pokémon is known for electric powers and red cheeks?
questions.fact: Clefairy was the original pick to front the anime. Pikachu got the job instead, largely because it appealed to boys and girls alike.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Indonesia?
questions.fact: Jakarta is sinking — parts of it by over 10 cm a year — which is why Indonesia is building a new capital, Nusantara, on Borneo.

questions.prompt: In 'Charlotte's Web,' what kind of animal is Charlotte?
questions.fact: Charlotte is a barn spider, and E. B. White gave her the full Latin honour: Charlotte A. Cavatica, after the species Araneus cavaticus.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Photoshop image editor?
questions.fact: Photoshop was written by two brothers, one of whom worked at Industrial Light & Magic. Adobe licensed it in 1988.
